top_signals.title: The Fed Will Deliver Price Stability, Warsh Says
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh holds a press conference after officials kept interest rates unchanged. He says inflation is still too high and policy makers will "deliver price stability." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Global Bond Sales Shatter Record, Fueled by AI Borrowing Binge
top_signals.summary: Global bond sales have soared to an all-time high, catapulted by breakneck borrowing from the tech juggernauts at the forefront of the AI boom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Weil leadership tells partners firm should be dissolved
top_signals.summary: Decision marks stunning downfall for near-century-old law firm that was among America’s largest and most prestigious

top_signals.title: Microsoft stock jumps 4% as cloud growth drives earnings and revenue beat
top_signals.summary: Microsoft reported better-than-expected results driven by 48% growth in Azure revenue.

top_signals.title: Japan has mastered the red carpet. Almost.
top_signals.summary: Japan's red carpets have glamour down to a science. But in the pursuit of perfection, something essential can get lost: spontaneity.

top_signals.title: Website used by hackers to leak info shut down, GMO says
top_signals.summary: The internet company has announced a bounty of up to $1 million for information leading to the group's arrest and launched a website to collect leads.
